limitations.detail: Lucy, Thai Statue, and Armadillo are 3 of the 4 paper shapes; this is never a full Table 3 or Global result.
Canonical Pitted Stonefish remains authorization-blocked; no substitute or numeric result was used.
The provenance-validated volumes use the documented Open3D reproduction protocol, not the authors' unreleased bit-exact C++/HIP converter.
Adam, seed 0, and MAPE epsilon 1e-6 are explicit frozen reproduction assumptions where the paper is silent.
The L1 config follows the published nine-method appendix subset and does not invent a Hash-PEPS row.
L1 Armadillo FLIP renders use the checked-in fixed camera because the paper camera is unavailable.
